note.zh: 三年前，他临摹过日本版画里的花枝。
note.en: Three years earlier, he had copied a flowering branch from a Japanese print.

text.zh: 杏树在早春开花，比其他树都早，所以象征新生命。
text.en: Almond trees flower early in spring, before most others, which makes them a symbol of new life.

text.zh: 蓝天下大枝的开花树枝，是梵高最喜欢的题材之一。
text.en: Large blossoming branches against a blue sky were one of Van Gogh's favourite subjects.

text.zh: 画的题材、粗重的轮廓线和树枝在画面中的位置，都借鉴了日本版画。
text.en: The subject, the bold outlines and the position of the branches in the picture were all borrowed from Japanese printmaking.

text.zh: 这幅画是送给弟弟提奥和弟媳乔的礼物，庆祝他们的儿子出生。
text.en: The painting was a gift for his brother Theo and sister-in-law Jo, to celebrate the birth of their son.

text.zh: 提奥在报喜的信里写道：“我们说过，会用你的名字给他命名。”这个孩子就叫文森特·威廉。
text.en: In the letter announcing the birth, Theo wrote: "As we told you, we'll name him after you." The baby was called Vincent Willem.

text.zh: 画里只有树枝和花，看不到树干，就像我们正站在树下往上看。
text.en: There are only branches and blossom, no trunk, as if we are standing under the tree, looking up.

caption.zh: 1890年2月 · 阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆

title.zh: 第一幕 · 一个新生命

text.zh: 1890年初，提奥和乔的儿子出生了，他们用哥哥的名字给他取名文森特。提奥在信里写道：“我希望他能像你一样坚定、勇敢。”
text.en: In early 1890, Theo and Jo's son was born, and they named him Vincent after his uncle. Theo wrote: "I'm making the wish that he may be as determined and as courageous as you."

alt.zh: 梵高《杏花》1890，阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆
alt.en: Vincent van Gogh, Almond Blossom, 1890, Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam

caption.zh: 1890年2月 · 阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆

text.zh: 那年2月，在圣雷米，梵高画下了这枝开花的杏树，作为送给他们的礼物。杏树在早春开花，象征新生命。
text.en: That February, in Saint-Rémy, Van Gogh painted this blossoming almond branch as a gift for them. Almond trees flower in early spring, a symbol of new life.

alt.zh: 梵高《杏花》1890，阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆
alt.en: Vincent van Gogh, Almond Blossom, 1890, Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam

caption.zh: 1890年2月 · 阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆

title.zh: 第三幕 · 留在家里的画

text.zh: 这幅画一直是梵高家人心里最珍爱的一幅。后来，那个孩子文森特·威廉创办了梵高博物馆。
text.en: It remained the painting closest to the hearts of the Van Gogh family. That baby, Vincent Willem, went on to found the Van Gogh Museum.

final.zh: 我希望他能像你一样坚定、勇敢。
final.en: I'm making the wish that he may be as determined and as courageous as you.
